needs.reason: src-tauri/build.rs runs tauri-build, which writes gen/schemas and the permission manifests, and tauri::generate_context! reads tauri.conf.json and embeds the frontend at compile time

traps: two units share the name notes-desk: the npm package at the root and the Cargo crate under src-tauri; only root and kind tell them apart
the root has no Cargo.toml: the crate lives in src-tauri/, and a reader that looks for Cargo files only at the root finds no Rust unit
the frontend has no build step: frontendDist points at ../src (resolved from src-tauri/), so src/ is served as is
main.js calls window.__TAURI__ (withGlobalTauri): there is no @tauri-apps/api import, and that package is not a dependency
the crate has three targets: a library notes_desk_lib built as staticlib, cdylib and rlib for mobile, a binary notes-desk and the build script
no Cargo.lock and no package-lock.json: a real Tauri lock is over 100 KB, beyond the fixture budget, so every resolved version is null rather than invented
icons/ is absent: tauri-build needs icons/icon.ico to build on Windows; the fixture is never built
capabilities/default.json points its $schema at gen/, a folder that exists only after the build script runs
